targets.name: Solidity.Lowering.V08.SourceRethrow.allocated_object
targets.boundary: Same newly allocated pointer and heap; no evaluator or canonical admission claim.

targets.name: Solidity.Lowering.V08.SourceRethrow.reached_rethrow
targets.boundary: Positive statement horizon and local reference to same newly allocated heap; no compiler-selected local/layout claim.

targets.name: Solidity.Lowering.V08.SourceRethrow.literal_rethrow
targets.boundary: Independent allocationFuel+4 and statementFuel+1 horizons; exact revert bytes and full post-allocation state.

targets.name: Solidity.Lowering.V08.SourceRethrow.statement_timeout
targets.boundary: Statement horizon zero; actual successful allocation retained in final state.

targets.name: Solidity.Lowering.V08.SourceRethrow.allocation_timeout
targets.boundary: Allocation horizon zero; arbitrary later horizon; full initial state retained.

targets.name: Solidity.Lowering.V08.SourceRethrow.intrinsic_rethrow
targets.boundary: Explicitly chosen revertData statement and arbitrary typed target state; empty/nonempty THalt.ofData distinction retained.

targets.name: Solidity.Lowering.V08.SourceRethrow.execution_transport
targets.boundary: Exact same payload parameter, but separate Source and target states; no compiler selection, physical relation or canonical endpoint binding.

limitations: All seven remain pending full parameter/joint feasibility and statement fidelity. No new producer needed for the stated local law; canonical transport still needs actual Source admission/origin/lifecycle and production body/frame correspondence, including the actual revert bridge. execution_transport is an independent-run conjunction, not compiler adequacy.
